create_IMAGENET_ITERATOR: create an ImageNet iterator to traverse image files and yield their paths with class IDs
shuffle_IMAGENET_DATASET: shuffle the ImageNet dataset using a random seed for reproducible training order
parse_WORDNET_ID: parse a WordNet ID from a string containing an ImageNet file path
get_CLASS_MAPPINGS: get the mapping from WordNet IDs to class indices for ILSVRC2012 ImageNet dataset
iterate_IMAGENET_SPLIT: iterate over the train or val split of an ImageNet dataset yielding paths and labels
